name: Riwayat Progress Tiket
query:
SELECT
	wl.parent AS "No Tiket:Link/NextHD Ticket:150",
	t.subject AS "Subjek:Data:220",
	t.status AS "Status Tiket:Data:120",
	wl.waktu AS "Waktu:Datetime:150",
	wl.teknisi AS "Teknisi:Link/User:150",
	wl.aktivitas AS "Aktivitas:Small Text:300",
	wl.hasil AS "Hasil:Data:130",
	wl.durasi_menit AS "Durasi Menit:Int:100"
FROM `tabNextHD Ticket Worklog` wl
INNER JOIN `tabNextHD Ticket` t ON wl.parent = t.name
ORDER BY wl.waktu DESC
